The '''Arah system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] installed a [[Arah mining facility|mining facility]] of [[oridium]] ore from which material was used for the [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE Phantom]] project. The facility however was [[Battle of Arah|destroyed]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rascal Squadron|Rascal Group]].<ref name="RA2" />
